items.title: The Real Future of AI and Work
items.summary: A weekend Long Reads episode built around Every's new Thesis Statements project — 100 builders and thinkers writing short essays on the future of work after automation. NLW reads through the first batch and argues the tired 'will AI take our jobs' debate is finally giving way to the questions that actually matter: how work, teams, companies, and human advantage get rebuilt.

items.title: Nine charged in Taiwan over 130 Nvidia B300 servers bound for China
items.summary:
Taiwanese prosecutors have indicted nine people over the alleged illegal export of high-end AI servers to China, among them an employee of Nvidia’s Taiwan operation and two from Super Micro. The charges are the first to emerge from an investigation that has run for months, having already produced detentions over server smuggling and reached inside Nvidia itself. […]

items.summary:
